note: File-scoped namespace (`namespace Ledger;`, the .NET 6+ default): every type is qualified Ledger.Account (ADR-003 D3). Formerly a known-gap (issue #14: _walk treated file_scoped_namespace_declaration as a container, but the tree-sitter grammar makes the type declarations its SIBLINGS, so they were walked with ns=None → unqualified FQNs). Fixed by applying a file-scoped namespace to its subsequent siblings in _walk. Ground truth is unchanged — it always encoded the correct qualified semantics.
